lines.x: It's funny, Umiri-chan always handles these things for us in Ave Mujica. So here, I have to adjust to managing my own schedule.

Lately, I've been stargazing on the deck with Astesia-san. The stars in Terra's sky are nothing like the ones I know. And when I tell her about our version of astronomy, I can almost see her hanging on every word I say.
Huh? You want me to teach you how to write lyrics...? Wait, Doctor, don't look at my terminal!

The cap and sunglasses? They're for wearing in crowded places, I guess. I work in the performing arts, so I'm kind of... a celebrity? I guess... Wait, Doctor, could it be you're a celebrity on Terra? Heheh. Look, you always have the hood on.
Sora-san always has such a warming effect on people, even when she's not performing. It'd be nice if I could fill everyone with that kind of warmth too.

I'd rather heal us all through music than fight. But... I get it. Becoming stronger is how I stay by Saki-chan's side. That's why I'll always keep putting in the effort, whether here on Terra or back in our world.

Ever since coming to Rhodes Island, we members of Ave Mujica have been spending a lot more time together. Once work's done for the day, we head to the studio to practice... It's kind of like we're all in a school club.

Ave Mujica has always meant so much to Saki-chan. And knowing how she treasures it, I want to protect it for her... I want to keep being Mujica's frontwoman, where I can live, breathe, and embody Mujica's world.

Ending up in a strange place and having to bond with strange people has taken a lot of energy, I'll admit, but getting to learn so much in exchange has all been worth it. I still barely know right from left here, but... I'd like to keep on bonding with the people of Rhodes Island, I think.
Maybe I'll brew some coffee and wait around until the Doctor wakes up?
Hello, I'm Uika... Misumi. Huh? You already heard about me from Saki-chan? How did she describe me, can you tell me?!
Are these all... actual battles you taped?
Rhodes Island's training program is incredible! I feel like it's building every part of me up at once. This is going to make concerts so much easier too!
I don't know when I'll end up home again. Is it really okay for you to pour so much into me, despite that...? Alright, thank you. I'll be sure to work hard to meet your expectations, Doctor.
As the squad's frontwoman, I'll lead the way for you all.
I've never been a leader to anyone before, but... I'll serve as a good example for you all!
Be careful out there!
Don't let your guard down. We can definitely win this!
I'll help out!
Doctor, I'm trusting you.
To your curtain fall... an elegy.
To our victory... a paean.
I'm going to sing.
Saki-chan, everyone, I'll protect you!
I'll cover you now!
Don't panic!
After getting back, let's take a nice hot bath, put on some relaxing music, and really unwind.
We're really getting into sync here!
I just hope nobody got hurt...
It's okay, I... I'll always be by your side.
It's really nice in here, isn't it!
One moment, let me put my guitar away... Okay, sorry about that. What do you need, Doctor?
Doctor! Want to go see the stars together?
Arknights.
Back in our world, everyone makes a wish on New Year's. Like this―you put your hands together, and close your eyes... If you have a wish, give it a try. It'll be nice if yours comes true too.
Good timing, I was just brewing coffee. Do you want some?

Happy birthday, Doctor! That tape's got a couple of songs on it. We wrote them for you, and for everyone at Rhodes Island. So even after we return to our old world someday, you'll still have these songs by your side forever.

When I first got here, I thought I was practically useless. But Rhodes Island is such a warm place, isn't it? It takes in any point of view, it gave me a role that I could play―I guess what I'm saying is, maybe I've earned the right to pride myself, as a member of Rhodes Island?
